pullUp.title: Pull-up
pullUp.formStandard: Dead hang start, chin over bar, no kipping, controlled lower.

pushUp.title: Push-up
pushUp.formStandard: Locked plank body line, controlled depth, full elbow extension.

plank.title: Plank
plank.formStandard: Straight body line, no sagging hips, steady breathing.

scapularPull.title: Scapular pull
scapularPull.formStandard: Arms straight, shoulder blades move without elbow bend.

deadHang.title: Dead hang
deadHang.formStandard: Full hang with controlled shoulders and no swinging.

hollowHold.title: Hollow hold
hollowHold.formStandard: Low back pressed down, ribs tucked, controlled breathing.

inclinePushUp.title: Incline push-up
inclinePushUp.formStandard: Strict push-up line with hands elevated.

pikePushUp.title: Pike push-up
pikePushUp.formStandard: Hips high, controlled press, head moves toward floor.

shoulderMobility.title: Shoulder mobility
shoulderMobility.formStandard: Pain-free range, controlled movement, no forcing.
